_comment: Connectors whose credentials live in the prism checkouts on the Linux box,
not in the local ~/.hyperswitch/creds.json the roster is generated from.
NAMES AND SLOT NUMBERS ONLY — never credential values.
`slots` records which hyperswitch-prismN checkouts hold them, because a
connector can only run in a slot that actually has its credentials.

saferpay.note: prism8 stores it without the connector_account_details wrapper and its contents differ slightly — check prism8's copy before using it
